title: Load refusal: sunElevation() in a match condition (a rule cannot trigger on the sun's position)
description: The sun's position is a function of the wall clock, not a datapoint: no update tells a match trigger to evaluate it again, so it is refused like the other time functions (spec/rules.md 2.3, 4.7, decision 13). A rule follows the sun with a timer (case 64).
